name: Pathfinder Cloud Environment
postCreateCommand: python3 -m venv backend/venv && ./backend/venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && cd frontend && npm install
postStartCommand: nohup ./backend/venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --app-dir backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 > /tmp/backend.log 2>&1 & cd frontend && npm run dev
